review_method: Independent mathematical review of the geometric proof and exact rational replay.
summary: Verified the signed selector census, exposure, exact affine radius bound at the origin, and all halfspace and volume cases. Independent enumeration confirmed 756 paired heavies, 630 unpaired one-zero threshold heavies, and 2709 remaining unpaired heavies. The rational replay verified 4,852 distinct bases and reproduced both strict cap margins and the total-volume surplus.
